preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The size of arrays A and B is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The absolute value of each element in array A is less than or equal to 10^5.
The absolute value of each element in array B is less than or equal to 10^5.
The number of operations K is between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the maximum value of interaction of the arrays.
